rationale: Both use backtracking with a used slice and a recursive closure. B is cleaner. It indexes dominoes by pip value, so the search only looks at candidates that can match the open end. One branch handles orientation by computing the next open value, and the recursion takes the current end as a parameter, which reads naturally. B also explains why starting each domino in its given orientation is enough, and it handles the single-domino case through the general logic. A duplicates the append/recurse/backtrack block twice inside extend and twice again in the start loop to cover both orientations. It adds a special case for n==1 and tries both start orientations, which is redundant. A is correct and well documented, but B has less duplication and a tighter design.
